data.maturity: SYNTHETIC VALIDATION — generated data, not live capture
data.note: risk_score carries deliberate Gaussian noise (sd 0.55) so the verdict bands overlap; a non-zero MAE floor is by construction

selection.protocol: RepeatedStratifiedKFold 5x5, shared folds across all candidates, preprocessing fitted inside each fold

architecture_evidence.reading: behaviour features carry no security signal, measured in both directions; the deterministic and ML planes are separate by evidence, not by assertion

limits: config features deliberately excluded — also unusable on ESP-only flows where IKE was never observed
top confusions are behaviourally adjacent: dns_query/icmp, email/web_browsing, video_streaming/file_transfer
voip recall of 1.000 on training data is a generator artefact and must not be quoted as a capability
24.8% of training rows sit in config combinations carrying more than one verdict — 100% is unreachable by construction
the rules engine owns the authoritative verdict; this model is parallel evidence, never the decision
a single tree matched an 18-candidate field within one standard deviation, so it was chosen for interpretability
HistGradientBoosting scored better (MAE 1.0023 vs 1.0399) but has no working skl2onnx converter — rejected on deployability, not accuracy
MAE is bounded below by the deliberate target noise

onnx.input_contract: each feature is its own named [N,1] input, not a single [N,k] tensor
onnx.dtypes: traffic_classifier all tensor(float); security_classifier and risk_regressor all tensor(string)

not_quotable: demo_weak / demo_strong accuracy (1.000) — extreme configs only, no Medium rows present, this is a demo not an evaluation
